Speech Script & Local Files

Prompter Settings

Font Size 38px
Adjust for comfortable reading at your distance.
Reading Column Width 900px
Narrower columns keep eye motion minimal so you look straight ahead.
Eye-Line Marker Height 38%
Place near the top to look straight into your webcam.
Color Theme
High-contrast black prevents screen reflections on your face or glasses.
3-Second Countdown Before Start
Gives you time to look up and smile before scrolling begins.

Keyboard & Clicker Shortcuts

Space or Click Stage Play / Pause scrolling
↑ / ↓ (Up / Down) Faster / Slower scrolling speed
← / → (Left / Right) Rewind / Jump Forward 5 seconds
Home Restart to beginning of speech
[ / ] Decrease / Increase Font Size
M Toggle Mirror / Flip (for glass teleprompter rigs)
G Toggle Eye-Line Guide Marker
H Hide / Show Controls Bar (Clean reading view)
F Toggle Fullscreen
E Open Script Editor / File Drop

Color Theme
High-contrast black prevents screen reflections on your face or glasses.

Gives you time to look up and smile before scrolling begins.

Prompter Settings

Font Size 38px
Adjust for comfortable reading at your distance.
Reading Column Width 900px
Narrower columns keep eye motion minimal so you look straight ahead.
Eye-Line Marker Height 38%
Place near the top to look straight into your webcam.
Color Theme
High-contrast black prevents screen reflections on your face or glasses.
3-Second Countdown Before Start
Gives you time to look up and smile before scrolling begins.

Keyboard & Clicker Shortcuts

Space or Click Stage Play / Pause scrolling
↑ / ↓ (Up / Down) Faster / Slower scrolling speed
← / → (Left / Right) Rewind / Jump Forward 5 seconds
Home Restart to beginning of speech
[ / ] Decrease / Increase Font Size
M Toggle Mirror / Flip (for glass teleprompter rigs)
G Toggle Eye-Line Guide Marker
H Hide / Show Controls Bar (Clean reading view)
F Toggle Fullscreen
